title: Manage conversation context to preserve critical information across long interactions
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Progressive summarization risks: condensing numerical values, percentages, dates, and customer- stated expectations into vague summaries
knowledge.evidence: EXAM12/18: progressive summary mất số/ngày/kỳ vọng.

knowledge.item: The "lost in the middle" effect: models reliably process information at the beginning and end of long inputs but may omit fi ndings from middle sections
knowledge.evidence: EXAM12: lost-in-middle là rủi ro vị trí input dài.

knowledge.item: How tool results accumulate in context and consume tokens disproportionately to their relevance (e.g., 40+ fi elds per order lookup when only 5 are relevant)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM12:40field chỉ5liên quan, lọc trước tích lũy.

knowledge.item: The importance of passing complete conversation history in subsequent API requests to maintain conversational coherence
knowledge.evidence: API02/19: gửi context/history và content blocks cho request sau.

skills.item: Extracting transactional facts (amounts, dates, order numbers, statuses) into a persistent "case facts" block included in each prompt, outside summarized history
skills.evidence: EXAM12/18Q1: case facts theo issue trong mỗi request ngoài history nén.

skills.item: Extracting and persisting structured issue data (order IDs, amounts, statuses) into a separate context layer for multi-issue sessions
skills.evidence: EXAM12: context layer có cấu trúc theo order/issue.

skills.item: Trimming verbose tool outputs to only relevant fi elds before they accumulate in context (e.g., keeping only return-relevant fi elds from order lookups)
skills.evidence: EXAM12: chỉ field tool liên quan, giữ nguồn để lấy lại.

skills.item: Placing key fi ndings summaries at the beginning of aggregated inputs and organizing detailed results with explicit section headers to mitigate position effects
skills.evidence: EXAM12: key findings đầu input, headers cho chi tiết.

skills.item: Requiring subagents to include metadata (dates, source locations, methodological context) in structured outputs to support accurate downstream synthesis
skills.evidence: EXAM12/03: metadata date/location/methodology giữ qua agents.

skills.item: Modifying upstream agents to return structured data (key facts, citations, relevance scores) instead of verbose content and reasoning chains when downstream agents have limited context budgets
skills.evidence: EXAM12: upstream key facts/citations/relevance thay verbose reasoning.

title: Design effective escalation and ambiguity resolution patterns
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Appropriate escalation triggers: customer requests for a human, policy exceptions/gaps (not just complex cases), and inability to make meaningful progress
knowledge.evidence: EXAM02: yêu cầu người, policy gap/exception, không tiến triển.

knowledge.item: The distinction between escalating immediately when a customer explicitly demands it versus offering to resolve when the issue is straightforward
knowledge.evidence: EXAM02Q2: explicit demand chuyển ngay, không ép điều tra.

knowledge.item: Why sentiment-based escalation and self-reported con fi dence scores are unreliable proxies for actual case complexity
knowledge.evidence: EXAM02: sentiment/confidence không là proxy đáng tin.

knowledge.item: How multiple customer matches require clari fi cation (requesting additional identi fi ers) rather than heuristic selection
knowledge.evidence: EXAM02Q3: nhiều customer matches cần định danh thêm.

skills.item: Adding explicit escalation criteria with few-shot examples to the system prompt demonstrating when to escalate versus resolve autonomously
skills.evidence: EXAM02: few-shot khách bực nhưng có thể xử lý so với explicit human request.

skills.item: Honoring explicit customer requests for human agents immediately without fi rst attempting investigation
skills.evidence: EXAM02Q2: tôn trọng ngay yêu cầu rõ.

skills.item: Acknowledging frustration while offering resolution when the issue is within the agent's capability, escalating only if the customer reiterates their preference
skills.evidence: EXAM02: thừa nhận frustration/đề nghị xử lý, tôn trọng nếu khách chọn người.

skills.item: Escalating when policy is ambiguous or silent on the customer's speci fi c request (e.g., competitor price matching when policy only addresses own-site adjustments)
skills.evidence: EXAM02Q3: own-site price adjustment không suy competitor matching.

skills.item: Instructing the agent to ask for additional identi fi ers when tool results return multiple matches, rather than selecting based on heuristics
skills.evidence: EXAM02Q3: hỏi identifier thay chọn theo heuristic.

title: Implement error propagation strategies across multi-agent systems
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Structured error context (failure type, attempted query, partial results, alternative approaches) as enabling intelligent coordinator recovery decisions
knowledge.evidence: EXAM03: failure/query/partial/alternatives cho coordinator.

knowledge.item: The distinction between access failures (timeouts needing retry decisions) and valid empty results (successful queries with no matches)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM03: access failure khác valid empty.

knowledge.item: Why generic error statuses ("search unavailable") hide valuable context from the coordinator
knowledge.evidence: EXAM03: generic unavailable thiếu tín hiệu phục hồi.

knowledge.item: Why silently suppressing errors (returning empty results as success) or terminating entire work fl ows on single failures are both anti-patterns
knowledge.evidence: EXAM03Q1: không che lỗi thành empty hoặc hủy mọi nhánh.

skills.item: Returning structured error context including failure type, what was attempted, partial results, and potential alternatives to enable coordinator recovery
skills.evidence: EXAM03Q1: structured context và attempts.

skills.item: Distinguishing access failures from valid empty results in error reporting so the coordinator can make appropriate decisions
skills.evidence: EXAM03: báo đúng access failure/empty.

skills.item: Having subagents implement local recovery for transient failures and only propagate errors they cannot resolve, including what was attempted and partial results
skills.evidence: EXAM03/11: local transient recovery giới hạn, propagate unresolved cùng partial/attempts.

skills.item: Structuring synthesis output with coverage annotations indicating which fi ndings are well- supported versus which topic areas have gaps due to unavailable sources
skills.evidence: EXAM03: coverage annotations chủ đề có support và gaps unavailable sources.

title: Manage context effectively in large codebase exploration
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Context degradation in extended sessions: models start giving inconsistent answers and referencing "typical patterns" rather than speci fi c classes discovered earlier
knowledge.evidence: EXAM12: typical-pattern answers thay class cụ thể/inconsistent findings là degradation.

knowledge.item: The role of scratchpad fi les for persisting key fi ndings across context boundaries
knowledge.evidence: EXAM12: scratchpad key findings có đường dẫn/bằng chứng.

knowledge.item: Subagent delegation for isolating verbose exploration output while the main agent coordinates high- level understanding
knowledge.evidence: EXAM12: nhánh khám phá giữ output dài, coordinator bức tranh tổng thể.

knowledge.item: Structured state persistence for crash recovery: each agent exports state to a known location, and the coordinator loads a manifest on resume
knowledge.evidence: EXAM12Q2: state exports nơi biết trước và manifest nạp khi resume.

skills.item: Spawning subagents to investigate speci fi c questions (e.g., " fi nd all test fi les," "trace refund fl ow dependencies") while the main agent preserves high-level coordination
skills.evidence: EXAM12: câu hỏi hẹp find-tests/trace-refund cho nhánh riêng.

skills.item: Having agents maintain scratchpad fi les recording key fi ndings, referencing them for subsequent questions to counteract context degradation
skills.evidence: EXAM12: scratchpad ghi và tham chiếu findings cho câu sau.

skills.item: Summarizing key fi ndings from one exploration phase before spawning sub-agents for the next phase, injecting summaries into initial context
skills.evidence: EXAM12: summary phase trước đưa initial context phase sau.

skills.item: Designing crash recovery using structured agent state exports (manifests) that the coordinator loads on resume and injects into agent prompts
skills.evidence: EXAM12Q2: manifest/state phải được load/inject, không chỉ tồn tại.

skills.item: Using /compact to reduce context usage during extended exploration sessions when context fi lls with verbose discovery output
skills.evidence: EXAM12: /compact cho verbose discovery, giữ facts/state trước nén.

title: Design human review work fl ows and con fi dence calibration
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: The risk that aggregate accuracy metrics (e.g., 97% overall) may mask poor performance on speci fi c document types or fi elds
knowledge.evidence: EXAM04:97%chung che field/loại hiếm yếu.

knowledge.item: Strati fi ed random sampling for measuring error rates in high-con fi dence extractions and detecting novel error patterns
knowledge.evidence: EXAM04: stratified random sampling nhóm cao đo lỗi mới.

knowledge.item: Field-level con fi dence scores calibrated using labeled validation sets for routing review attention
knowledge.evidence: EXAM04: field confidence cần labeled calibration.

knowledge.item: The importance of validating accuracy by document type and fi eld segment before automating high- con fi dence extractions
knowledge.evidence: EXAM04: verify accuracy theo type/field trước giảm review.

skills.item: Implementing strati fi ed random sampling of high-con fi dence extractions for ongoing error rate measurement and novel pattern detection
skills.evidence: EXAM04Q3/18Q3: tiếp tục stratified sampling high-confidence.

skills.item: Analyzing accuracy by document type and fi eld to verify consistent performance across all segments before reducing human review
skills.evidence: EXAM04Q1: phân tích theo field/doc type.

skills.item: Having models output fi eld-level con fi dence scores, then calibrating review thresholds using labeled validation sets
skills.evidence: EXAM04Q2: model score không tự là xác suất đúng, calibrate threshold với nhãn.

skills.item: Routing extractions with low model con fi dence or ambiguous/contradictory source documents to human review, prioritizing limited reviewer capacity
skills.evidence: EXAM04Q3: low confidence/ambiguity/conflict ưu tiên human capacity.

title: Preserve information provenance and handle uncertainty in multi- source synthesis
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: How source attribution is lost during summarization steps when fi ndings are compressed without preserving claim-source mappings
knowledge.evidence: EXAM03Q3: summary dễ làm mất claim-source mapping.

knowledge.item: The importance of structured claim-source mappings that the synthesis agent must preserve and merge when combining fi ndings
knowledge.evidence: EXAM03: synthesis merge giữ liên kết claim/location/source.

knowledge.item: How to handle con fl icting statistics from credible sources: annotating con fl icts with source attribution rather than arbitrarily selecting one value
knowledge.evidence: EXAM03Q2: annotating conflicts thay chọn trung bình/tùy tiện.

knowledge.item: Temporal data: requiring publication/collection dates in structured outputs to prevent temporal differences from being misinterpreted as contradictions
knowledge.evidence: EXAM03: publication/collection dates phân biệt temporal difference.

skills.item: Requiring subagents to output structured claim-source mappings (source URLs, document names, relevant excerpts) that downstream agents preserve through synthesis
skills.evidence: EXAM03: structured findings URL/document/excerpt/location/date/methodology.

skills.item: Structuring reports with explicit sections distinguishing well-established fi ndings from contested ones, preserving original source characterizations and methodological context
skills.evidence: EXAM03: established/contested/gap sections giữ characterization nguồn.

skills.item: Completing document analysis with con fl icting values included and explicitly annotated, letting the coordinator decide how to reconcile before passing to synthesis
skills.evidence: EXAM03: document analysis giữ các giá trị, coordinator đối chiếu trước synthesis.

skills.item: Requiring subagents to include publication or data collection dates in structured outputs to enable correct temporal interpretation
skills.evidence: EXAM03Q2/18Q2: giữ date để không hiểu hai thời kỳ là contradiction.

skills.item: Rendering different content types appropriately in synthesis outputs— fi nancial data as tables, news as prose, technical fi ndings as structured lists—rather than converting everything to a uniform format
skills.evidence: EXAM03: financial tables/news prose/technical structured lists theo kiểu dữ liệu.
